steps.content: You take a good look around the house.
Overall, the furnishings of the house are not much different from most ordinary families in Eastside, adequate but unremarkable.
A sturdy wooden table. Old-fashioned home appliances. Some items on the cabinets seem to have been removed, leaving only the dusty marks in their original positions.
Clearly, no one has taken care of this place for a long time. This matches the Bureau's findings.
Something does feel off here... If the aunt's family is indeed gone, why does Oliver return here so often? And what's the deal with the harmonious family the neighbors see?
But if they still live here... You carefully observe the surroundings. It's very quiet. Besides you and Oliver, you don't feel the presence of a third person.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Are you sure you don't need more support?

I'll be fine on my own. Oliver has been able to evade capture so many times, the kid must be highly vigilant. It'd look less suspicious if I go alone. I can gain Oliver's trust more easily and try to pry for more information.
If we directly take Oliver back to the MBCC for interrogation, I don't think the kid will tell the truth.
As for the peculiarity of this family, I'll have to go into the house and see for myself.
A Mania-like scent seems to permeate the space. You instinctively search for its source and glimpse a hastily closed door left ajar.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: What are you looking at, sir? You wanted to sit down and rest, no?
steps.female_content: What are you looking at, miss? You wanted to sit down and rest, no?

steps.content: Oh right... Cough, cough... I must be too tired. I'm feeling a bit dizzy...

options: Where are the adults of your family?

choices.text: Where are the adults of your family?

steps.content: Staying alone in this house must be so lonely...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: The adults... My parents passed away a long time ago. I've been living with my aunt and her family ever since.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: But you know, I'm not their biological child after all... I understand it...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: It's okay, don't worry about me! Take your time and rest well, sir!
steps.female_content: It's okay, don't worry about me! Take your time and rest well, miss!

steps.content: How unfamiliar this kind face seems to you. Oliver takes over the conversation skillfully and brushes the dust off the couch thoughtfully, inviting you to sit down.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: You must be exhausted after what you've been through, right?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: May I offer you a shoulder massage?
Before you even answer, Oliver moves closer. The bandage around Oliver's neck has come undone, revealing the bruises underneath.
Although it's clear Oliver shows them to you on purpose, you still play along and express your concern.
Oh no! Did you get hurt?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Ah... No, it's nothing! You didn't see anything!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I'm fine. It'll get better soon. It doesn't hurt at all...
Oliver tightens the sleeve even more. The dark bruises are particularly noticeable against the pale skin.
Don't tell me... your aunt and her family did this?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: It's Oliver's fault. Oliver couldn't win the affection of Auntie's family... I'm not good enough for them.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: They're the only family Oliver has left. The more they see me as a burden, the more I want to prove myself.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I work and tell lies for them. I've tried so hard... But all I've ever gotten is punishment.
Oliver's hands shake with the sobs, but the massaging motion never stops.
Why don't you run away if they're treating you so poorly?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: ...Me? Where can I go on my own?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oliver is trapped here forever if I can't find someone kind and rich like you to take me in, sir.
steps.female_content: Oliver is trapped here forever if I can't find someone kind and rich like you to take me in, miss.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Indeed... Auntie doesn't let me eat. My cousin forces me to wear her old dresses. My uncle vents his anger by beating me. But what can I do...
Oliver looks at you with envy, but then tactfully averts the gaze and continues to massage you conscientiously.
The kid knows when to push and when to take a step back. This must be a skill Oliver has honed over time. Fortunately, you are well aware of the purpose of your visit.
The dilapidated house is still quiet. The inexplicable surge of Mania is still active. You sigh as you look at the injuries on Oliver.
Oliver, do you think you're a good child?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Huh?
Those forced tears haven't dried yet. Oliver looks up at you a little confusedly.
How they treat you has nothing to do with who you really are.
Sincerity and kindness... These are the true criteria of a good child.
If you think you're a good child, I'd be happy to help you escape from here and buy you the best toy in Eastside.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: A toy! Really? Does Oliver deserve something so nice?
Oliver skillfully avoids the topic of good child and focuses on the benefits you can provide.
You don't press Oliver for an answer yet and pretend to cough weakly.
I don't remember the last time I met a child I got along with so well! We've been chatting non-stop, I'm a bit thirsty.
Can you pour me a glass of water?
The change of topic is admittedly quite abrupt, but it's enough to coax a child. Thinking of the toy you mentioned, Oliver frowns but still nods and dashes off.
You quietly wait for a while. Once you hear the running water, you stealthily approach the source of the Mania activity.
Darkness.
Utter darkness.

You grope your way down the stairs and enter the basement behind the door. You hear some faint noise in the darkness, repeating over and over again in a fixed rhythm, reminding you of the long, disorderly legs of an arthropod.
The basement is dark, slippery, and humid. In the damp air, you can smell a rotten stench.
In the thick shadows, you vaguely see several overlapping human figures.
Are those... mannequins?
As you fumble your way closer, you see three lifelike mannequins. Dressed in old and discolored clothes, they lie haphazardly on a three-legged wooden table, miraculously maintaining their balance.
As you lock eyes with the three mannequins, the strange feeling in your heart grows stronger.
No, these are no ordinary mannequins...

You lean in a bit closer and notice that the mannequins' fingers are firmly pressing against the table. Their fingertips are straining to support the weight of their entire bodies, the bones almost protruding...
Oops...
You've found out.
You hear Oliver's voice behind you. Tap, tap, tap.
Holding a toy unicorn, the Sinner steps toward you. The glass in Oliver's hand is empty.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I was wondering why you chose to rest at my place, sir... It's quite bizarre, isn't it?
steps.female_content: I was wondering why you chose to rest at my place, miss... It's quite bizarre, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Well, well... Even more bizarre, I was already making myself sound so pitiful, yet you still had no intention of helping me.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: You even tried to teach me a lesson!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Ah, I remember now. A seemingly gullible person who turns out to be so adamant and preachy... I think I've met someone like that before...
Oliver throws the empty glass onto the floor with a cold expression.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: You're that rag doll from the toy factory, aren't you?
The shattered glass breaks the unsettling balance. The three puppets can no longer control their bodies and fall to the ground all at once.
Before hitting the ground, they suddenly leap up in inhuman postures, firmly grabbing the table, their limbs flailing.

They're chatting and hugging each other intimately, their dancing limbs twisting in the opposite direction of their joints. They make the silhouette of a harmonious family as described by the neighbors.
What controls their movements are the dense fine threads in the room formed by the Sinner's special power.
These threads fill the entire space and also surround you.
Now that you've recognized me, let's have a heart-to-heart? I remember you once said that the toy factory was just a distasteful parody of a family? Then what is this...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Shut up!
The threads wrapped around the three people are retracted all at once, converging into a force that shoots right in your face!
You're as impatient as always. Too bad, I'm no longer that rag doll you could push around.
Red spikes spread out and cut off Oliver's powerful attack, piercing into Oliver's body.
As the red light flickers, the Mania is temporarily suppressed and all those threads are rendered futile.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Mmph! You...
Knocked down by the power of the shackles, Oliver cries out in shock. At the same time, the aunt's family seem to have regained their souls, screaming as they feel the irresistible pain...

steps.speaker: Aunt
steps.content: Oliver, you dirty little rat! Give it to me! Where did you hide it!

steps.speaker: Uncle
steps.content: Oh... I can repay you soon! Don't chase after me! Just sell that little punk to them!

steps.speaker: Cousin
steps.content: How dare you do this to us... Useless burden! We'll beat you to death and throw you out!
Biting back the pain, Oliver hugs the toy unicorn tightly and covers its ears.
The chaotic and excited murmurs sound especially harsh in the basement. You send a call to Nightingale...
Sinner Oliver has been shackled and successfully detained.
I've found Oliver's family too...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Haha, you call them... my family?
Slumped on the floor, Oliver lets out a snicker, curling up around the toy and muttering...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: There's nothing I despise more...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Than family...
